body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It starts at Overhoeksplein 51.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Soar like an eagle and swoop over some of Holland's best bits! Thanks to THIS IS HOLLAND's huge spherical screen and a host of cool special effects including wind and smells (the nice kind, don't worry), you can tour the Netherlands without moving your feet. See Heritage Sites, windmills, Amsterdam's famous canals, and more, with THIS IS HOLLAND Amsterdam tickets.
>
> This simulated flight takes you over important Dutch World Heritage sites, so expect to see things like Amsterdam's famous canal ring, the Wadden Sea and of course, plenty of windmills!
>
> Travel through mist, wind and different smells and fall in love with the feeling of flying. In fact, it could be the perfect warm-up flight for someone who's afraid to head to Schiphol.
>
> It's a multi-sensory experience that will make you feel like a _flying Dutchie_ in no time!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €27.00. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 257 ratings and 119 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
